title: SEMINAR ON HOSPITALITY INDUSTRY
duration: 45 hours (30 hours theory and 15 hours discussion/practical)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to analyze current industry trends and issues.
Capacity to critically evaluate and debate contemporary hospitality topics.
Effective time management in preparation for seminars and assignments.
Developing skills to present information clearly and persuasively.
Conducting research on hospitality industry issues and presenting findings.
